score_100.reason: This rubric allocates most of the score to the core scientific result: pairwise morphological similarity scores of 121 cerebellar efferent neurons (91 eurydendroid cells and 30 Purkinje cells) at 6 dpf were computed with the NBLAST algorithm and subjected to unsupervised hierarchical clustering using Ward's method, yielding a dendrogram with eight major clusters in which cluster 7 contains exclusively all Purkinje cells while the remaining eurydendroid cells are distributed across the other seven clusters. These quantitative, methodological, and clustering claims define the main scientific conclusion about the morphological organization and classification of cerebellar output neurons. Dendrogram visualization details and background interpretation should receive little or no weight unless they help preserve the core meaning.

rubric.GT core conclusion: Pairwise morphological similarity scores of 121 cerebellar efferent neurons (91 eurydendroid cells and 30 Purkinje cells) from the larval zebrafish brain at 6 dpf, computed using the NBLAST algorithm, were subjected to unsupervised hierarchical clustering with Ward's method; the resulting dendrogram is shown with colors indicating the eight major clusters, revealing that one cluster (cluster 7) consisted exclusively of all Purkinje cells while the remaining eurydendroid cells were distributed over the other seven clusters.
